environment.profile: local acceptance on Darwin arm64; synthetic fixtures only

BIO-RPT-004-AC01.finding: The service resolves tenant context server-side and the endpoint verifies cryptographic actor provenance before tenant-scoped dashboard permission and any health-source access.

BIO-RPT-004-AC02.finding: Drill-down links reuse the shell's existing route permission metadata and are hidden per role.

BIO-RPT-004-AC03.finding: Panels distinguish live, stale and unavailable data; failed reads retain real last-known values and observation times or show null when no successful observation exists, never fabricated zeroes.

BIO-RPT-004-AC04.finding: DashboardService exposes no tenant-id input and tenant-keyed gateways/cache prevent cross-tenant aggregation.

BIO-RPT-004-AC05.finding: The approved dashboard surface is connected through ReportingService in an explicitly documented HYBRID state: SIMULATION proves the six-panel workflow and role-filtered drill-downs; the real LIVE path proves fail-closed 401 behavior because no browser provenance transport exists yet. A positive LIVE browser-to-API workflow must be re-verified when TD-WEB-PROVENANCE-BRIDGE lands.

commands.result: UNAVAILABLE in acceptance sandbox: compilation stalled without output and was stopped; exact-commit builder and reviewer evidence records a clean build and 30/30 tests

open_follow_up_obligations.required_action: Re-run BIO-RPT-004's positive LIVE browser-to-API workflow with a real provenance-bearing browser session and confirm the authenticated operational-health snapshot plus role-filtered drill-down flow succeeds end to end.
open_follow_up_obligations.current_negative_proof: The real LIVE adapter/backend path correctly rejects the current proof-less browser request with 401 actor_provenance_required.

final_acceptance.reason: AC01-AC04 and the documented AC05 HYBRID boundary map to exact-commit implementation, tests, builder evidence and independent QA PASS. Fresh structural, focused frontend, traceability, module-direction and secret checks pass. Acceptance preserves an explicit open obligation to positively re-verify the LIVE browser-to-API workflow when TD-WEB-PROVENANCE-BRIDGE lands.
